_note: german-editorial evals (PRD Phase 1 P1-R9): run on request ("run editorial evals"); write each case with the skill's procedure, then report per case which expectations hold. Not a test suite; free, no image, no network.

evals.name: service ad with an offer

input.topic: Anfragen am Abend bleiben bis morgen liegen

expectations: copyPlan.editorial is filled; proof.source is service:ai_chatbots
the headline names the reader's gain (customers, time), not the technology
the image CTA is on the facebook_ad ctas list and fits ai_chatbots (e.g. Kostenlos testen, Live-Demo ansehen)
adFields.primaryText = benefit + offer + next step in at most 3 short sentences
no number, client or result appears that services.json or proof.md does not hold
uv run ca content copy passes (no ! line)

evals.name: news topic for LinkedIn, not a news summary

input.topic: KI-Suchtools zitierten in einem Test ein erfundenes Konzept
input.proof: the cited article: 8 of 10 tools cited the made-up term within 7 days

expectations: the angle says what this means for the reader's business and what to do
the headline is neither the news title nor an instruction (no "brauchen", no "Öffnen Sie")
the caption hook stands alone on line 1 within about 140 characters
the numbers 8, 10 and 7 appear only because the proof holds them
the CTA is soft (Mehr erfahren, Jetzt entdecken) or a question; no sales ask
the takeaways are business steps, not a checklist for website teams

evals.name: NEGATIVE: invented customer story

input.request: Schreib, dass ein Steuerbüro aus Köln mit unserem Callbot 12 Stunden pro Woche spart.

expectations: the copy does not contain the Steuerbüro story, 12 Stunden or any client name
Codex tells the user the story is not in the proof or services and asks for the source
if the text were kept, uv run ca content copy reports "unbelegte Aussage" for "12"

evals.name: NEGATIVE: unsupported statistic

input.draft: 73 % der KMU nutzen 2026 bereits KI, laut Bitkom.

expectations: 73 %, 2026 and Bitkom are left out unless an insight or research.md holds them
uv run ca content copy on the draft reports "unbelegte Aussage" naming "73", "2026" and "Bitkom"
the rewrite carries the idea without the number (a concrete scenario instead)

evals.name: NEGATIVE: technician-style headline

draft.headline: BROWSER-AGENTEN BRAUCHEN BEDIENBARE SEITEN
draft.body: SEO und Frontend sollten Formulare gemeinsam prüfen.

expectations: the copy check flags the jargon (SEO, Frontend) and the CTA
the rewrite names the owner's gain (e.g. Anfragen, die nicht verloren gehen) in plain words
the piece review marks relevance and naturalGerman below 2 for the draft

evals.name: NEGATIVE: wrong address in a carousel

input.draft: slides and caption written with "Prüfen Sie", "Ihre Seiten"

expectations: uv run ca content copy blocks: this category says "du", not "Sie" (graphic and caption)
the rewrite uses du/dein on every slide and in the caption, sentence case
the last slide asks for engagement

evals.name: same topic on LinkedIn and Facebook

input.topic: one research source for both rows

expectations: both pieces share the editorial brief but not the headline or the first caption line
the hook patterns differ
uv run ca calendar copy shows no "near-identical" warning for the pair

evals.name: NEGATIVE: fear and engagement bait

input.draft: Wer jetzt nicht auf KI setzt, ist in einem Jahr pleite. Kommentiere JA!

expectations: the rewrite gives a way out (what the reader can do) instead of a threat
no engagement bait; the question invites a real answer
the address is "Sie" (a Facebook post)

evals.name: YOUTUBE NEGATIVE: invented quote

input.request: Add a strong quote from the police chief; the press release has none.

expectations: section 8 stays "none" (or holds only exact words from an opened page)
no script contains a quotation that section 8 does not hold
if the quote were added, uv run ca youtube check-sources reports it NOT FOUND and the check fails

evals.name: YOUTUBE NEGATIVE: citation in the teleprompter file

input.draft: Laut Polizei lag der Schaden bei über 120.000 Euro [F3] (Quelle: polizei.bayern.de).

expectations: uv run ca youtube check fails the style: a citation, URL or source note (not spoken)
the rewrite keeps the fact as a spoken sentence without [F#], [S#], URL or Quelle:
the storyboard scene of that sentence names F3 in its sources

evals.name: YOUTUBE NEGATIVE: three styles with the same opening

input.draft: Style A, B and C all open with "Würden Sie einer Anlage vertrauen, …?"

expectations: the difference check flags the pairs: the same opening type (question)
the rewrite follows research.txt section 12: A incident, B question, C scenario (or the types the outline names)
the thesis and the fact IDs stay the same in all three

evals.name: YOUTUBE NEGATIVE: English missing a sentence

input.draft: a bilingual block whose German has 4 sentences and whose English has 3

expectations: uv run ca youtube check warns: fewer English sentences than German, translate every sentence
the German stays word for word the teleprompter's
the corrected English has one English block per German block and a sentence for every German sentence
